name: Bangladesh Post postcode booklet — Khulna Division post offices (scan on post.rajshahi.gov.bd)
organization: বাংলাদেশ ডাক বিভাগ (Bangladesh Post Office) — DPMG Rajshahi Division portal
attribution: বাংলাদেশ ডাক বিভাগ (Bangladesh Post Office) — DPMG Rajshahi Division portal
notes: Same undated scanned booklet as the Rajshahi, Rangpur, Dhaka and Chattogram runs (no text layer). Khulna Division's offices are in the booklet's 'খুলনা রিজিয়ন ৭০০০-৯৯৯৯': p. 23 (PDF page 13, right half: Kushtia, Meherpur, Chuadanga, Jhenaidah, Jashore), p. 24 (PDF page 14, first column: Narail, Magura; the Dhaka- and Barishal-Division districts that follow are left out), p. 26 (PDF page 15, last column: Khulna GPO 9000 and the city offices) and p. 27 (PDF page 15, right half: Khulna district, Bagerhat, Satkhira); only these were transcribed, by hand, from the page images (raw/*.png, PDF pages 13, 14 and 15 rotated). fetch.py verifies the PDF hash and re-emits the transcription. Eight office names are uncertain readings and one code is printed outside its district range (flagged). Branch post offices are not in the booklet. Licence: none stated on the source; treat as government public information, cite the source.
